# Canadian Centre for Addictions

> Luxury addiction treatment and recovery centre offering medical detox, rehab programs, and aftercare support across multiple Canadian locations with accredited facilities and evidence-based outcomes.

Canadian Centre for Addictions is a leading addiction treatment provider in Ontario and beyond, operating luxury rehab facilities in Cobourg and serving patients across major Canadian cities including Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal, and others. The organization partners with healthcare institutions like Northumberland Hills Hospital and emphasizes evidence-based treatment, high success rates, and comprehensive community support.
